snippet.title: Character Limit - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
12 Letters, No Mercy. Wishlist Character Limit on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4121620/Character_Limit/

Character Limit is a fast-paced word game where you must make up words to clear the ever-filling rack. You just got to remember the golden rule: Don't fill the rack. 

With the game constantly getting faster, how long will it be before you hit your Character Limit? 

Release expected for Summer 2026
Demo coming soon. 
Also coming to iOS/iPadOS. 

Hotel Outlaw is an indie studio from Swansea, South Wales, making weird little games with an outlaw spirit.  Character Limit is its first release.
